review_findings.title: Strip Content-Range from decoded responses
review_findings.implementation: decodedGzipResponseHeaders removes Content-Range from the decoded view; wireHeaders keeps it unchanged.

review_findings.title: Return terminal EOF and empty reads before checking the operation context
review_findings.implementation: GzipBodyStream.read returns zero for an empty destination first, treats verified EOF as terminal before any context poll, and no longer re-polls the context after a verified zero-length decode.

review_findings.title: Preserve transport diagnostics when contextual cancellation wins
review_findings.implementation: gzipContextualFailure keeps the contextual category/phase/code but copies nativeCode, localEndpoint and remoteEndpoint from the racing NetworkException and retains it as the cause.

review_findings.title: Unregister partial callbacks when immediate invocation throws
review_findings.implementation: HttpCancellationHandles.retainCancellation unregisters every accumulated registration when a later registration or its synchronous invocation throws, then rethrows the original failure.

review_findings.title: Link typed cancellation into decoder admission
review_findings.implementation: GzipClient.send links the caller context and every typed handle into one published CancellationSource before buffer admission, and passes that token as the admission context. The same token is published as response.operationContext, so a cancelled handle wakes the blocked admission waiter as a classified cancellation.

review_findings.title: Keep the published context linked through decoded EOF
review_findings.implementation: The decoded response publishes the linked token instead of the request operation's own token, and retains the parent registration plus the typed-handle lifetime until the decoded body reaches EOF, failure or close.

review_findings.title: Classify pre-submission cancellation as admission
review_findings.implementation: checkGzipAdmissionContext reports NetworkPhase.PoolAcquire for the pre-admission/pre-submission cancellation and deadline checks; body-phase checks keep NetworkPhase.HttpBody.

review_findings.title: Preserve HTTP/2 receive headroom when reserving gzip storage
review_findings.implementation: checkGzipReceiveHeadroom rejects a decoder reservation that leaves less than one 16 KiB minimum DATA frame in the route/origin/instance DATA capacity, before submission, with a typed ResourceExhausted/PoolAcquire error.
